name: WEUSD
oneLiner: WEUSD is PicWe's omni-chain USDT wrapper minted and redeemed 1:1 against USDT; the token has been trading off-peg near $0.91 despite documented backing.
collateral: 100% USDC-backed omni-chain stablecoin per current PicWe documentation (Phase 1: minted 1:1 against USDC, with the official contracts page naming per-chain USDC as the reserve/redemption asset); future RWA/yield collateral (tokenized treasuries, real estate, commodities) is described as Phase 2 roadmap rather than current backing
pegMechanism: Per current PicWe docs, WEUSD is minted 1:1 against USDC and redeemed to USDC anytime via PicWe's on-chain mint/redeem contract; the protocol holds USDC reserves against circulating WEUSD.

notices.title: Active depeg
notices.message: WEUSD has been trading near $0.91 despite documented 1:1 USDT backing; redemption pipeline may be impaired.

mintAuthority.summary: WEUSD is minted and redeemed through PicWe's omni-chain protocol via AccessControl tokens whose live BSC/Base/Arbitrum roles resolve to a PicWe admin/minter EOA plus a mint/redeem contract; the basket-style backing (roughly 9 USDT + 1 MOVE) explains the persistent ~$0.91 trading level.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Live role checks on BSC, Base, and Arbitrum resolve this EOA as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and a current MINTER_ROLE holder; signer policy was not decoded.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD mint/redeem contract
controls.evidence: PicWe docs identify this contract as the WEUSD mint/redeem handler, and live role checks on BSC, Base, and Arbitrum resolve it as a current MINTER_ROLE holder.

review.evidence: WEUSD is PicWe's omni-chain settlement currency minted/redeemed via PicWe's protocol; the token contract is OpenZeppelin AccessControl with a MINTER_ROLE gating mint. Live BSC/Base/Arbitrum checks resolve PicWe EOA 0xc12233455beac4e094a5de022be692a264c0c0bc as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and one MINTER_ROLE holder, and 0x5D54f1092FD1750A3ab96972dc1867c5B23eF22C as an additional mint/redeem MINTER_ROLE holder. The basket economic model (about 9 USDT + 1 MOVE per 10 WEUSD) is the documented reason for the sub-$1 floor rather than a pure 1:1 USDT wrapper.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm Plume and Movement WEUSD role holders and whether the admin EOA is controlled by a multisig, MPC, or other policy layer.
